locator.title: Показываем, что за элитный ЖК строят напротив Кремля
locator.lead: Рассказываем о премиальном комплексе «Царев сад» в историческом районе Москвы
locator.caption: Архитектура «Резиденции 1864» продумана так, чтобы не выбиваться из облика города

nearest_text_before.text: «Резиденция 1864» стоит на Софийской набережной, прямо напротив Кремля, поэтому отсюда удобно добираться в любую точку города. Рядом любимые бутики, рестораны, музеи и памятники архитектуры — жители комплекса находятся в центре культурной жизни.

image_reading: A large pale-stone residential complex fills the center of the frame above a bridge and river, with a symmetrical, historically styled façade.
Leafy trees frame the foreground and right side; their branches are the clearest naturally movable elements, while the building remains fully visible and visually dominant.
Small vehicles and street fixtures appear below the façade, but they are secondary to the architectural view.
analysis.article_context: The body image follows the section on the complex’s central Moscow location and is captioned to emphasize that its architecture fits the historic cityscape. The animation should contrast the calm, enduring façade with subtle natural movement around it, keeping the residence as the dominant subject.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The residence appears composed and enduring within the greenery and historic urban fabric of central Moscow, supporting the article’s claim that its architecture harmonizes with the city.
structured_intent.primary_action: A light breeze gently moves the foreground foliage.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The foliage has eased toward a gentle resting position while the main façade remains unobstructed and clearly recognizable.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The residential façade remains the stable, dominant architectural subject and continues to feel integrated into its surroundings.

models.scene_plan: For the full 3.2-second fixed shot, a mild breeze begins immediately and moves the visible foreground foliage with small, coherent side-to-side displacement. The motion remains restrained so it frames rather than obscures the architecture, then naturally eases in the final moments with the leaves slightly settling and the entire main façade still clear.
models.positive_prompt: A light breeze gently sways the foreground leaves and thin branches in one continuous motion while the camera stays fixed on the residence. The movement eases near the end, with the façade still fully visible and dominant.
